basics.label: Research Scientist, Solar Physics
basics.summary: Research Scientist at Southwest Research Institute working on solar transition-region and coronal diagnostics, spectropolarimetry, and physics-informed machine learning for magnetic field inversions.

work.name: Southwest Research Institute
work.summary: Solar transition-region and coronal diagnostics using SolO/SPICE; development of coronal magnetic-field diagnostics and physics-informed ML methods for spectropolarimetry.
